answer_1.quote: We aim to develop a multimodal model able to generate dialogues that resemble human dialogue strategies.

answer_2.quote: We compute the percentage of games with repeated questions and with the last turn containing a positively answered question. Moreover, we employ CHAIRs to measure the percentage of hallucinated entities in a sequence...

answer_4.quote: We asked human subjects to guess the target given a dialogue. We sampled 500 games from the GuessWhat?! test set... In total, 10 English proficient volunteers within our organization joined the experiment.
answer_4.guideline: human annotators to guess the target object given the dialogues generated by Confirm-it
